content.short: Birdeye Data Services is a high-performance on-chain data API platform offering real-time token, wallet, trading, and DeFi protocol data for developers on Mantle.
content.description: Birdeye Data Services (BDS) is a professional-grade blockchain data API platform providing comprehensive real-time and historical on-chain data including token prices, wallet tracking, trading activity, and DeFi protocol metrics. Originally known for its Solana analytics, BDS has expanded to cover multiple chains including Mantle, offering developers a reliable data layer for building trading tools, analytics dashboards, and data-driven dApps.
content.meta: Birdeye Data Services provides real-time multi-chain on-chain data APIs for developers building on Mantle. Discover Birdeye Data Services and other Infrastructure Tools on Lancers Web3 Explorer.
